Who I Am

About Me

I am a results-driven digital marketer with hands-on experience building, managing, and growing websites and digital channels from the ground up. I've independently delivered full-stack digital marketing across two real-world brands — from writing a single line of website code to closing the loop with analytics and ad performance reports.

My work spans website design and development (WordPress/WooCommerce), on-page and technical SEO, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, paid advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), social media management, and creative content production.

Every number in this portfolio is backed by a real screenshot or tool export — not a claim, but proof.

Skill 01

Website Design & Development

Built two fully functional websites from scratch using WordPress, WooCommerce, and Elementor — covering UI design, plugin management, responsive layouts, payment/checkout flows, and ongoing maintenance.

Wivid Wear
www.wividwear.com

Mental-health-inspired fashion e-commerce brand. The client had no web presence and needed to launch from zero — no website, no brand assets, no digital channels.

What I did: Designed and built the full WordPress/WooCommerce site from scratch — homepage, product shop, blog, contact form, cart/checkout, wishlist, track-order page, and newsletter sign-up. Set up GA4, GTM, Google Search Console, and Yoast SEO. Then managed all Instagram and paid Meta ad campaigns alongside the website.

Result: A fully operational e-commerce store with 511K+ accounts reached on Instagram in 30 days, 5.9M reel reach in 90 days, and a live analytics + ads setup that enabled data-driven decisions from day one.

Protone by Aanya
www.protone.fit

Fitness and nutrition coaching platform for ISSA-certified nutritionist Aanya Sharma. The client needed to move her coaching business online — with a way to sell digital products, build authority through content, and attract clients via search and social.

What I did: Built the complete WordPress/WooCommerce site — digital product shop (recipe books, workout plans, detox plans), custom TDEE calculator, client reviews page, blog, FAQs, and contact page. Managed SEO for 15+ blog posts, ran Google Ads smart campaigns, and handled all Instagram content and strategy across two accounts — @aanya_sharmma_ (personal brand, 10K+ followers) for nutritionist credibility and authority, and @protone.fit (brand page, 1,486 followers) for product and business awareness.

Result: 12,700+ backlinks built organically, 1,486 Instagram followers on the brand page, a Google My Business listing with a 5-star rating across 24 reviews, and a live revenue-generating digital product store.
